Dear Catalyst Review Team,
We are resubmitting Milestone 2, Proof of Achievement for Project Catalyst 1300083. M1 has now been signed off, and this resubmission directly addresses the three points raised in the previous M2 review: actual attendance, actual number of feedback responses, and a written summary report on feedback collection.
1. Attendance
The acceptance criteria committed the webinar to be "held online and publicly accessible, with a duration of at least 30 min." That is where the milestone has delivered the strongest return: a full-length, on-demand session for the Cardano community, actively promoted across multiple channels and reaching a substantially wider audience than the live session alone.
Live attendance came in below what we had hoped for: 14 registrants and 10 attendees on the day. The project's energy was concentrated on the recording and its post-event distribution: a publicly accessible asset that compounds in value over time, rather than a one-time live broadcast.
Recording YouTube, Decoding Legal: Part Two: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pyYM-Dxe5yw 110+ views as of 2026-04-29, available on demand indefinitely
